purpose: GAP-28 faithful-direction R6 live sweep: flip the easy-tier beta direction (0.75 -> 0.25) by setting the tier-aware n_cap factor to 1.5, and re-run the 3-seed N=1000 paired pLDDT sweep.
gpu_note: GPU0 only; matches the recorded R6 hard constraint ('cuda:0 ONLY'). GPU1 was contended by another project's mol-metal job at capture time.
command_executed: Three independent single-seed invocations run in parallel (seeds are independent; folding caches PDBs): for S in 42 43 44: .venvs/lineageflow_venv/bin/python tools/sweep_r6_tier_aware_live.py --outdir verification_outputs/gap28-r6-faithful --seeds $S --n 1000 --tier-aware-n-cap 1.5 --gpu 0 --fold-baseline --pair-with fresh > verification_outputs/gap28-r6-faithful/driver.seed$S.log 2>&1
parallelization_note: The sequential driver was stopped after ~40 min (seed42 generation done, ~420/1000 baseline chains folded). It was relaunched as three concurrent single-seed drivers on GPU0 (which was only ~28% utilised during folding). Seeds are independent and folding is deterministic, so per-seed results are identical to the sequential run; only wall-clock changes. The per-seed sweep_summary.json race is harmless (the pooled sweep_summary.json is rewritten by tools/gap28_aggregate.py after all seeds finish).
pairing: within-seed fresh baseline fold (--pair-with fresh); the frozen Wave 161 baseline metrics drive tier assignment only
mechanism_check: N=20 pilot: factor 1.5 vs 0.5 framework arms differ on exactly the easy-tier records (5/20: q5,q8,q9,q10,q19); baseline byte-identical. N=1000 confirm: vs the as-designed run, exactly the 330 frozen-easy records per seed differ; hard 0/330 and medium 0/340 byte-identical.

result.verdict: DEFINITIVE_NULL: the faithful direction (easy beta 0.75 -> 0.25) LOWERS the pooled d_z vs the as-designed run (+0.1466); the GAP-01 s4.5 direction-mismatch hypothesis is refuted
